label: Postgres: Insert Row
description: Insert one row into a table, columns from a JSON object, and get the inserted row back (defaults and generated ids filled in).

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: The row as column: value pairs, e.g. { "email": "a@b.c", "age": 30 }.

outputs.name: row
outputs.description: The inserted row as the database stored it.
